title: Shrine of the Drowned God
description: A shrine built from layered shells and living coral stands in a grotto where the tide barely reaches. Offerings of driftwood and pearl line the altar, left by hands long gone. The air hums with something old and patient.

choices.label: Pray at the shrine
choices.description: The sea god's blessing washes over you like a warm current.

choices.label: Offer gold at the altar
choices.description: A generous offering earns a deeper blessing.

choices.label: Take the pearl offering
choices.description: The pearl gleams with iridescent light. Surely no god will miss it.

choices.label: Leave the shrine undisturbed
choices.description: Some things are better left to the deep.
